scope: Early independent read-only foundation inspection, not feature acceptance or final review target

findings.title: Failed durable transfer must not publish composer transient empty as the saved draft
findings.evidence: prepare finally invokes endHandoff on rejection; endHandoff enqueues deferred data. If initial draft save committed but command prepare rejects, a deferred transient empty can replace the original durable draft.
findings.required: Only commit successful transfer and preserve failed source draft/receipt; distinguish real next draft from pre-onNew empty notification. Cover save success -> prepare reject -> transient empty -> reload.

findings.title: Version increments are not compare-and-swap admission
findings.evidence: change reads current record then updates without expected version/owner generation; prepare permits same frozen record; dispatch unconditionally sets dispatching. Two tabs can both admit same record and stale checkpoint can regress a later accepted record.
findings.required: Bind expected record version/dispatch ownership generation and terminal progression; one contender wins, stale holder cannot overwrite it. Same-key idempotent server handling does not replace required local CAS.

findings.title: Bind queued draft/restore operations to their captured namespace and connection generation
findings.evidence: enqueue captures data before deferred run but resolves current namespace/owner only inside run; restore reads list under one namespace then only checks UI plugin state before callback. A switching host can retarget data unless caller-specific invariants prevent it; App binding remains unfinished.
findings.required: Capture namespace/owner/local generation synchronously and verify before/after awaits; old A data must not write/hydrate B. Final App integration should test this invariant explicitly.

findings.title: Pre-send storage failure must retain an explicitly retryable original identity
findings.evidence: RecoveryError before sent is classified rejected; retry only accepts unknown, unresolved excludes rejected, and executing again allocates a new key and replaces the same slot. Analogous classification exists in projection/steering.
findings.required: Represent write-before-send blockage without treating it as a definite center rejection; preserve original key/body/materials, allow explicit exact-identity retry after storage recovers, send zero HTTP on barrier failure.

findings.title: Explicit logout should synchronously revoke business authorization
findings.evidence: logout increments private generation but leaves published phase ready until awaited HTTP finishes; authorized() and public csrfToken() remain usable.
findings.required: Publish revoked/checking state immediately; privately capture CSRF for the one logout request, stop observation/writes and retain journal. Separate from pending center Set-Cookie race policy.
